authority: T0 analytic theorem for the bounded-renormalized-matrix centered-nodal Q3 family: whole-Wick uniform exponential integrability, full-sequence L1/total-variation and reflection-positive configuration limit, exact affine-seam formula, locally uniform shifted integrability, and fixed-band full-sequence regular Weyl limit; claim-nonbearing and not an original fixed-raw, complete OS/Hadamard, physical-state, C6, CP1, or Pre-A theorem

external_authority.general_multivariate_variational_method: H. Nagoji, arXiv:2305.19583v2, Theorem 1.7(i) and Sections 3.3-4.1
external_authority.scalar_lattice_method_precedent: N. Barashkov, T. Gunaratnam and M. Hofstetter, arXiv:2207.13673v3, Sections 2 and 5, especially Lemma 5.9
external_authority.vector_nodal_precedent: M. G. Delgadino and S. A. Smith, arXiv:2601.19630v1, Definition 3.1 and Appendix D
external_authority.boundary: None of these sources states the hybrid continuous-time centered-dispersion, non-radial eight-component Q3, matrix-counterterm, or shifted affine-seam theorem proved here. They are method precedents, not imported closure.

setup.domain: T_beta0 times Lambda_M, Lambda_M=Z/MZ, a=L/M, dz_M=dt*a*sum_j, M even
setup.free_operator: A_M=m0^2-partial_t^2-Delta_a with centered symbol khat_a(k)^2 and m0>0
setup.field: eight independent real Gaussian components Y_M with covariance A_M^(-1)
setup.interaction: P_M(x)=x^T K_M x/2+W4(x), sup_M||K_M||<=kappa, g>0, lambda>=0, W4(x)>=g|x|^4/32
setup.signed_action: R_M=-integral :P_M(Y_M):_(sigma_M) dz_M using whole-polynomial Wick centering at sigma_M=E Y_M(z)^2
setup.excluded_family: the original cutoff-independent raw CL8 quadratic is excluded; K_M is the bounded renormalized matrix of the EXP-000765 tuning

scalar_convention.ordinary_quadratic_relation: R_whole equals the ordinary-K plus Wick-W4 exponent plus the deterministic volume scalar (C/2)TrK
scalar_convention.probability_invariance: deterministic scalars cancel from normalized densities but not from raw exponential moments
scalar_convention.energy_boundary: the centering is a probability normalization and does not establish an absolute energy or a below-empty-space sign

uniform_exponential_integrability.theorem: for every s>0, sup_M E exp(s R_M)<infinity
uniform_exponential_integrability.finite_mode_reduction: apply finite-dimensional Boue-Dupuis to a temporal projector and a bounded truncation, use the exact H1 control inequality, remove the bounded truncation by monotone convergence, then remove the temporal projector by fixed-M Wick convergence and Fatou
uniform_exponential_integrability.cross_exponents: with epsilon=1/8 and r=1,2,3, ||I^r||_(W^(epsilon,4/r))<=C||I||_4^(r-1/4)||I||_H1^(1/4); generalized Young uses q_r=(16/11,16/7,16/3)
uniform_exponential_integrability.absorption: choose the finite-support Young deltas so a positive multiple of ||I||_4^4 and one quarter of ||I||_H1^2 remain
uniform_exponential_integrability.random_remainder: a finite sum of negative-Sobolev Wick norms with maximal required moment 16/3

all_M_Wick_Besov.cyclic_lift: every degree-d cyclic spatial momentum equation lifts to finitely many ordinary sectors m+ell M, |ell|<=d
all_M_Wick_Besov.convolution:
for d<=4 and every eta>0, the ordinary massive two-dimensional convolution obeys c^(*d)(p)<=B_(d,eta)

^(-2+eta); the logarithmic border is absorbed into eta
all_M_Wick_Besov.dyadic: the lift bound gives E|Delta_j :Y^gamma:(z)|^2<=C 2^(eta j); choose eta<2epsilon and use finite-chaos hypercontractivity plus the Littlewood-Paley square function
all_M_Wick_Besov.result: for every multi-index 1<=|gamma|<=4 and every finite p,q used in the drift estimate, sup_(M,N) E||:Y_MN^gamma:||_(W_M^(-epsilon,p))^q<infinity
all_M_Wick_Besov.positive_space_constants: piecewise-linear spatial extension, cellwise Lp equivalence, exact discrete derivative energy, continuum two-dimensional GN, the discrete Leibniz identity and interpolation give M-independent fractional product constants including Nyquist modes

density_limit.input: EXP-000770 proves R_M tends to R in L2 and every fixed finite Lp
density_limit.Vitali: the s=2 estimate makes exp(R_M) uniformly integrable; convergence in probability gives exp(R_M)->exp(R) in L1
density_limit.normalizers: Z_M=E exp(R_M)>=1 by centering and Jensen, and Z_M tends to Z
density_limit.result: rho_M=exp(R_M)/Z_M converges to the Nagoji Q3 density rho in L1 and total variation along the full sequence
density_limit.reflection_positivity: the exact finite centered time-local reflection forms pass through the L1 density limit

affine_seam.shift: r_h(t)=(t/beta0-1/2)h on [0,beta0), with h in a fixed smooth spatial band
affine_seam.phase: the Weyl midpoint is phi(0), so no extra endpoint half-phase remains
affine_seam.shifted_UI: for every s>0 and every compact H in a fixed h-band, the Boue-Dupuis proof with I+r_h gives sup_M sup_(h in H) E exp(s[R_M(Y+r_h)-L_(M,h)(Y)])<infinity
affine_seam.sawtooth: the periodic representative is BV and is a uniform W^(epsilon,p) multiplier for epsilon<1/p; epsilon=1/8 works for every exponent used
affine_seam.shifted_convergence: Wick translation, fixed-band shifted alias sectors ell M+O(K), and A_(x,M)h->A_xh give locally uniform action convergence; shifted UI and Vitali give locally uniform seam-numerator convergence

Weyl_limit.result: the exact EXP-000770 midpoint identity and affine-seam convergence give full-sequence locally uniform convergence of the centered interacting Weyl characteristics on every fixed finite symplectic mode space
Weyl_limit.positivity: finite Weyl positive-type matrices pass to the limit
Weyl_limit.regularity: EXP-000771 fixed-low-mode equicontinuity and the locally uniform seam formula make the limit regular
Weyl_limit.boundary: this is an inductive finite-mode regular CCR state, not complete OS/Markov reconstruction, a local-net theorem, KMS uniqueness, or Hadamard form

verification.fixtures: Q3 coercivity and Wick scalar ledger; Hermite translation; epsilon=1/8 generalized-Young exponent derivation; centered-symbol sandwich; cyclic and shifted lift enumeration including Nyquist; discrete Leibniz and interpolation controls; finite-dimensional Boue-Dupuis oracle; affine free-action beta/24 and A_x ledger; Vitali and normalizer algebra; raw-family, scalar-energy, prior-art, below-empty-space, and unchanged-C6 firewalls

prior_art_boundary: General multivariate terminal normalizability, scalar lattice Nelson estimates, radial vector nodal convergence, reflection positivity and Weyl reconstruction are prior art. No located theorem directly supplies this hybrid centered-dispersion, non-radial Q3, matrix-counterterm and affine-seam result. The bounded audit is not a global novelty proof or a world-first claim.
no_overclaim: This theorem applies only to the tuned bounded-renormalized-matrix centered-nodal Q3 family on the inserted one-dimensional finite Euclidean torus, with g>0, lambda>=0 and m0>0. It does not rehabilitate the original fixed-raw CL8 family or turn Wick centering into an absolute energy. It does not prove complete OS/Markov/Hadamard structure, a beta-independent Hamiltonian or physical beta/ground/KMS criterion, the original three-dimensional Q3 parent, a physical vacuum or energy below empty space, a phase transition, physical light, C0, N1-N5, C6, CP1, Sector A, or Pre-A.
